CustomField.description: SLA remaining percentage at or below which the Agent Work Panel displays the countdown in amber (warning). Must be greater than SLA_Critical_Threshold_Pct__c and less than 100. When null, the panel falls back to 50. Subscriber-tunable — admins can relax or tighten the warning band per routing scenario without code changes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Remaining % at which the SLA countdown turns amber. Must be > Critical % and < 100. Defaults to 50 if blank.
CustomField.label: SLA Warn Threshold %
